name: Camping/Wohnmobilstellplatz Hotel Krimmlerfälle
beschreibung: The Hotel Krimmlerfälle Camping & Caravan Park is located near the Krimmler Waterfalls in Tyrol. It provides stalls for RVs and tents with electrical connections. The sanitary facilities are modern and clean. Guests have access to the waterfalls and hiking trails. A restaurant in the hotel serves visitors with meals. The area is ideal for nature lovers and hikers. The site is perfect for short stays to explore the National Park.
